main_body: bonsai/pine tree with layered foliage pads and curved trunk
top_band: upper lit green canopy pads in rows 1-17 (each foliage pad has ~4-6 rows of lighter green top surface above a darker underside)
evidence: The tree shows clear 3/4 canopy volume with broad top-lit foliage clusters (rows 1-18) casting eave shadows onto the underside and the curved trunk below (rows 18-44).

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference trees, the candidate has a continuous heavy dark outline around every foliage pad and the trunk, giving a sticker-like cartoon silhouette. The foliage pads use blocky 3-4 shade bands rather than fine multi-step leaf clumping, and the trunk is a simple tube with minimal bark and root detail.
